entries.description: End of a listing for a farm-oriented homestead of 2 lesbians on 22 acres, earning from bees, honey and rare poultry, with graphic design, photography, writing, and lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps. Welcomes correspondence with lesbians and offers apprenticeships/work exchanges in beekeeping and permaculture.
entries.raw_text: oriented homestead whose main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry. Off-farm income is derived from graphic design, photography and writing for the organic agriculture journals. We also produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name of Armadillo Mountain. Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land. Longer-term apprenticeships/work exchanges are a possibility. Would also trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture (particularly dryland and forage systems) for some good, solid vocational skills, especially carpentry and stone masonry. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 22 acres, good tools and equipment, dogs, cats, chickens, ducks, guineas, peabirds and 60 zillion bees.
entries.notes: Continuation of a listing from the previous page; name 'Armadillo Mountain' appears only as a product name, so community_name left blank per instructions. Type: Private/Individual Land by two-woman rule ('2 lesbians'); apprenticeships do not change it. Accepted group: Lesbian women from 'correspondence with other lesbians'. Num residents blank: no statement that women live on the land. Focuses: Farming from 'main farm income is from sales of bees and honey'; Workshops/education from 'apprenticeships'; Environmentalism from 'Permaculture' and organic agriculture journals (weak; permaculture is an explicit practice they teach). Archives/cultural work not coded: t-shirts/stamps are products, not clearly cultural work. Location unknown from this page.

entries.description: Inactive farm of 2 lesbians caretaking 147 acres with housing, camping space, woods and farm land; needs energy and money support to stay open for women and children; no alcohol, drugs or violence; encourages women of color; welcomes new members/caretakers, children, non-lesbian women, donations.
entries.raw_text: OWL FARM POB 133, Days Creek, OR 97429. We are two winmin caretaking OWL since Aug 82. OWL is needing energy and money support from winmin to stay open for winmin & children. No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence. I encourage winmin of color to come and be here. We welcome: new members/caretakers, girl children, boy children (under 10 years), nonlesbian women, dogs only if restrained, donations. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 147 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farm land, winmin living and working the land. Inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type: two caretakers ('We are two winmin caretaking', '2 lesbians') so Private/Individual Land by two-woman rule; it is not recruiting residents as a group, and OWLT is buying it (see below). Land city from POB town: listing's address is a PO box, so land_city not guaranteed; inferred Days Creek from mailing city only weakly, no 'Located in' phrase. Accepted groups: Lesbian women from '2 lesbians' living there and 'winmin... to stay open for winmin & children'; Non-lesbian women named; girl and boy children named (boy children under 10 years). Num residents 2: '2 lesbians' and 'winmin living and working the land'. Focuses: Recovery/substance-free from 'No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence'; Women of color from 'I encourage winmin of color to come and be here'. Inactive group with hopes to revive.

entries.description: Land trust in the process of buying OWL Farm; supported by donations, issues a quarterly newsletter, holds meetings about every three months at the farm, and a collective of women caretakes the farm. Welcomes new members, girl and boy children, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 1692, Roseburg, OR 97470. OWLT is in the process of buying OWL FARM (see above). Support for the farm and trust comes from donations from those women who believe in land for women. A quarterly newsletter is printed, $5/year. Land trust meetings are held about every three months at the farm. A collective of women (the number fluctuates) caretakes the farm. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type: Land Trust by name and purpose ('Land trust meetings'). Land state OR inferred because it is buying OWL Farm (Days Creek, OR); no city given. Accepted groups: Non-lesbian women, girl and boy children named; Lesbian women inferred from 'land for women' and members being welcomed. Number of residents blank: 'the number fluctuates'. Acreage not stated for the trust itself (see OWL Farm: 147).

entries.description: Family of 4 lesbians on 40 acres of secluded forest hilltop growing food and making art and song celebrating woman; hold theatre and Tai Chi workshops for women several times a year; no visitors at other times.
entries.raw_text: FLY AWAY HOME POB 593, Myrtle Creek, OR 97457. We are a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop. We grow food and tender our emotional and spiritual depths. And we make art and song that celebrate woman. We invite women to our workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi several times during the year. We are unable to welcome visitors at other times. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative: 'a family of 4 lesbians living on' the land (three or more). Land state OR inferred from mailing address; PO box so no street/zip. Accepted groups: Lesbian women from '4 lesbians' and 'We invite women to our workshops' (not coded as non-lesbian women since lesbians named only). Residents 4: 'women living and working on the land'. Focuses: Farming from 'We grow food'; Spirituality from 'tender our... spiritual depths'; Archives/cultural work from 'we make art and song'; Workshops from 'workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi'. Setting phrase 'secluded forest hilltop'.

entries.description: Partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres of forested property managed by thinning and reforestation for selective timber harvest and firewood; woman-built cabin, outbuildings, garden, chickens, pets. Not separatists; welcome children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: STEPPING WOODS Rt 4 Box 1058, Roseburg, OR 97470. We are a partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres of forested property. We manage our woods by thinning and reforestation, where necessary, for selective timber harvest and firewood. There is one woman-built cabin, a few out buildings, a garden, chickens, and pets. We are not separatists and have male friends that come on our land. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity/privy, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Private/Individual Land by two-woman rule ('a partnership of 2 lesbians'); no recruitment of residents. Rural route address is the land, so copied to land_*. Accepted groups: girl and boy children and non-lesbian women named; Lesbian women from '2 lesbians'. Male friends visit but men are not listed as welcomed, so not coded. Residents 2: 'women living and working on the land'. Focus: Farming/self-sufficiency weakly from garden and chickens only; not clearly a purpose, but forest management (selective timber harvest, firewood) is a stated activity - coded cautiously. Listing rejects separatism ('We are not separatists'), so Lesbian separatism not coded. Acreage 130 (OCR text shows '1[3]0').

entries.description: Rural feminist publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image) run by 2 lesbians aged 57 and 60 on 6+ acres, interested in photography, ecology and alternative technology; welcomes women of all ages for short or long visits at $4/day including vegetarian meals; rules against men, guns, pets, drugs or dope.
entries.raw_text: ROOTWORKS 2000 King Mountain Trail, Sunny Valley, OR 97497. A rural feminist publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image) with strong interests in photography, (summer Ovulars), ecology and alternative technology. We are 57 & 60 years old. We enjoy the company and help of women of all ages who can adapt to our simple lifestyle for short or long visits. Rules: no men, guns, pets, drugs or dope. Smoking limited to outdoors gravel area. $4/day/woman includes vegetarian meals. We welcome: nonlesbian women, women to help on projects. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 6+ acres, housing/permanent structures, outdoor toilets, electricity with generator and batteries, camping space, woods, gardens, women living and working with the land.
entries.notes: Type: Private/Individual Land by two-woman rule ('2 lesbians'); visitors do not change it. Street address is the land. Acreage 6 from '6+ acres'. Accepted groups: Non-lesbian women named; Lesbian women from '2 lesbians'; 'women of all ages' read as lesbians and non-lesbian women (pre-1986). Men not welcome ('no men'). Residents 2: 'women living and working with the land'. Focuses: Archives/cultural work from 'feminist publishing center'; Environmentalism from 'ecology and alternative technology'; Recovery/substance-free from 'no... drugs or dope'; Older women not coded (they are 57 & 60 but do not center older women).

entries.land_location_as_stated: a large island off the coast of Maine
entries.description: Womyn's rooming/guest house in a partially restored large Victorian on a large island off the coast of Maine; rooms $21 including tax, one bathroom, kitchen use, parlour; 2 lesbians live there with a dog and cat. Welcomes girl children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: SEA GNOMES HOME Box 33, Stonington, ME 04681 (207)367-5376. We are a womyn's rooming/guest house situated on a large island off the coast of Maine. Rooms are $21 including tax. The house is a large Victorian, partially restored, one bathroom, kitchen use, large parlour. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 1 dog, 1 cat, house, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Included under the editors' note (groups that 'don't have land, perse'). It is a guest house on its own island property (house with a parlour on 'a large island'), so judged to be a row, unlike Gabriel's in a town. Type: Retreat/Gathering Space: defined by what it offers visitors ('rooming/guest house'). Land city Stonington inferred from mailing address (island location is stated but not exact). Residents 2: '2 lesbians' but listing does not say they live on land; however it is their house, so count taken from '2 lesbians' - treat with caution. Accepted groups: girl children and non-lesbian women named; Lesbian women from '2 lesbians'. No acreage.

entries.description: Notice that multiple-ownership land holdings ended in legal dissolution; some members persevere in spirit and a large womyn's community exists in the area.
entries.raw_text: OZARK WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 718, Fayetteville, AR 72702. We have tried multiple-ownership (partnership) type of land holding. The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually. Some of us persevere in the spirit. We cannot guarantee to answer letters, but if you are prepared to spend a little time in the area, a land search may be fruitful. A large wimmin's community exists.
entries.notes: Not a listing: land 'wound up in legal dissolution'. Land state AR inferred from mailing address.

entries.description: Letter from Ambitious Amazons thanking LC for the directory and correcting a misprinted phone number; continues on the next page.
entries.raw_text: Dear Ambitious Amazons: Thanks for the Land Directory and including us, it might be a problem, however, that our phone number was misprinted. Our real phone can be rung at (617)585-8826. We tried out the
entries.notes: Not a listing: letter correcting a listing. The letter is addressed 'Dear Ambitious Amazons' (apparently LC's reply format, so the writer's group is unclear); name taken from the salutation. It is cut off at the page bottom and continues on the next page. The 'Dear LC' letter about making a living is a general reader letter, not from a listed community, so not extracted.
